errors.what: First drafts of README and post quoted 76 release-check lines (the 4-track EP's count) and 27,009,000 scanline bytes; measured 31 and 27,003,000 before commit and corrected.
Deleting globalThis.Buffer to simulate a browser broke Node's own CompressionStream/Response (undici and zlib streams use Buffer internally); the test hands Buffer back for the deflate call only.

doc_friction.issue: Replacing a 67-char item with a slightly longer one took four tries at 1986 of 2000 characters; the tool says the max fits, which helped, but the row is permanently at the cap so every landing becomes a wording squeeze.
